name: Otama (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Otama village emblem in navy: a broken ring with a pointed stroke at the upper fly.
history: Municipal flag of Otama, a village in Fukushima Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 26 June 1972.

features.role: Otama village emblem — a broken ring with a pointed stroke at the upper fly
